title: Reader Lock-to-Write Lock Deadlock Upgrade
pattern: An active reader lock holder attempts to acquire a writer lock on the same `RwLock` without releasing the reader lock first.
why_bad: If multiple threads attempt this upgrade concurrently, they will deadlock waiting for each other to release their reader locks, as writer acquisition requires zero active readers.
detection: A write lock acquisition nested inside the scope of an active read lock on the same `RwLock` instance.
counterexample: Context-dependent: Some specialized read-write locks support a safe `upgrade()` method which explicitly handles the upgrade step atomically or safely releases and re-acquires.
